messages:
devon: Heads-up — onboarding a new model to the catalog, need quick checks before we pin and start canaries. weights are uploaded.

miguel: Which model is this? name + tag?

devon: redwood-mistral-lite-3b, tag=2026-03-12-v0.9. weights at s3://redwood-weights/models/mistral-lite/2026-03-12/v0.9/weights.tar.gz

olivia: thanks. Any tokenizer notes? we had issues last time with eos/pad mapping on Mistral family.

devon: yes — tokenizer uses <|endoftext|> as eos, but the internal token id mapping in the repo shows pad_token=None. inference runtime expects pad_token set for batching.

devon: config I pushed to the model card:
```json
{
  "model_name": "redwood-mistral-lite-3b",
  "version": "2026-03-12-v0.9",
  "weights_path": "s3://redwood-weights/models/mistral-lite/2026-03-12/v0.9/weights.tar.gz",
  "max_sequence_length": 2048,
  "tokenizer": {
    "cls_token": null,
    "sep_token": null,
    "eos_token": "<|endoftext|>",
    "pad_token": "<pad>",
    "padding_side": "right"
  },
  "runtime_optimizations": ["kv_cache", "dynamic_batching"],
  "fallback_variants": ["fp16", "int8_q4_0"]
}
```

infra-bot: model-lint: tokenizer.pad_token set to <pad> — OK. max_sequence_length <= 4096 — OK. weights checksum matches — OK. validation: partial-pass (see comments).

miguel: partial-pass? what failed?

infra-bot: validation note: kv cache shape mismatch for sequence lengths >1024 on current runtime kernel, triggers a warning. recommended kernel update or set max_sequence_length = 1024 for initial rollout.

olivia: kernel update is a couple-day change. I'd rather reduce max_sequence_length to 1024 for canary and then enable 2048 after kernel patch.

devon: fine. I'll update model card to 1024 and push a re-validate. also want to pin catalog entry to catalog:v1.18 (new pinning scheme).

sara: canary plan? region enablement?

devon: proposed plan: 1% traffic (us-central1) -> 5% (us-central1 + eu-west1) -> 25% global (exclude ap-southeast1) over 48 hours, monitoring gating on latency, error-rate, and generation-quality evals. rollback to fp16 variant automatically on >3% error rate increase.

jack: how do we wire fallback to fp16/int8? need model variants in the catalog and a routing policy.

devon: I've added fallback_variants in the model card (see above). routing policy is in rollout config:
```yaml
rollout:
  initial: 0.01
  steps:
    - pct: 0.05
      regions: ["us-central1", "eu-west1"]
      wait_hours: 12
    - pct: 0.25
      regions: ["us-central1", "eu-west1"]
      wait_hours: 36
  fallback_on_errors: true
  fallback_targets: ["fp16", "int8_q4_0"]
  metrics_gates:
    latency_p95_ms: 500
    error_rate_pct: 0.3
    quality_regression_delta: 0.02
```

miguel: suggestion: start in eu-west1 first for GDPR customers? or do us-central1 first for lowest latency?

olivia: prefer us-central1 first — our infra is warm there and we have reserved capacity. eu-west1 on second step is fine. postpone ap-southeast1 until we validate memory patterns because of the kv cache warning.

devon: noted. I'll change max_sequence_length to 1024, push new card, run validation, and kick off a canary PR for the catalog pin.

infra-bot: model-validate run queued: rictl model validate --config model.card.json --weights s3://redwood-weights/models/mistral-lite/2026-03-12/v0.9/weights.tar.gz --max-seq 1024

devon: pinging @olivia for quick thumbs on the updated tokenizer and rollout policy when you have 10m. :eyes:

olivia: I'll review in ~30m. quick note — include a small eval set for regression checks (the prompt set we use for Mistral regressions).

devon: added eval set path to card: s3://redwood-evals/mistral-lite/regression-v1.jsonl

jack: code-review ping: I left a small comment on the catalog PR about the variant naming conventions (prefer variant names like v0.9-fp16 rather than fp16 alone).

devon: good catch — will rename fallback targets to ["2026-03-12-v0.9-fp16","2026-03-12-v0.9-int8_q4_0"] in the card and update routing.

miguel: once infra-bot validation passes, let's schedule the canary to start tomorrow 09:00 PST. I'll own monitoring dashboards during the first step.

devon: thanks. final checklist for me: update max_seq->1024, rename variants, add eval set, re-run validation, push PR for catalog pin (catalog:v1.18), and schedule canary.

olivia: sounds good. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: model-validate completed: PASS (all critical checks OK). Warnings: kv-cache kernel compatibility for >1024 (mitigated by max_sequence_length=1024).

devon: perfect. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/482 — tag me on approvals and I'll schedule the rollout.

jack: approved.

miguel: I'll set the canary cron. everyone else — post any last concerns here, otherwise we go live tomorrow.

olivia: no blockers from me.

sara: all clear from security side.

devon: awesome — thanks team.
